scope.frame_inventory: Part_0000.bi4 through Part_0400.bi4, contiguous and source-bound

preconditions.unlock_rule: No V8 frame is opened until the actual V7 report, V7 source contract, and V7 completed execution receipt are bound by exact case identity and SHA.

massfluid_contract.comparison: every decoded frame metadata MassFluid is packed as little-endian binary64 and must equal V7 raw_bytes_hex byte-for-byte
massfluid_contract.official_path: JSph XML MassFluid -> solver float -> ConfigSaveData -> JPartDataBi4::ConfigCtes -> JBinaryData::SetvDouble -> serialized JPartDataBi4 MassFluid

mass_denominators.xml_whole_initial_fluid_mass: generated XML fluid count multiplied by source XML MassFluid; this is the frozen .003 unknown-identity screen denominator
mass_denominators.native_whole_initial_fluid_mass: generated XML fluid count multiplied by the exact decoded native MassFluid; report separately
mass_denominators.native_excluded_mass: native omitted identity count multiplied by exact native MassFluid

frame_processing.decoder: official pinned bi4_dump through fixed direct-converter backend registration
frame_processing.backend_module_registration: insert the exact module name into sys.modules before dataclass-decorated import and remove only the temporary name on failure
frame_processing.lifecycle: saved-frame identity censoring only; re-entry and hidden continuous events remain UNKNOWN

input_stability.pre_snapshot: all 401 frame stat+full SHA and all small inputs before decoder opens any frame
input_stability.post_snapshot: same frame and small-input stat+full SHA after final native join
input_stability.first_frame_sha_provenance: V7 worker pre/post source when supplied by V7; do not relabel as a parent full-frame hash

claim_boundary.native_numerical_identity_and_motive: SOURCE_CLOSED only after exact V7 gate, all-frame exact-bit gate, and complete pre/post stability equality
